# directus_permission (Resource)

Manages a Directus permission rule attached to a policy (directus_permissions). Custom (non-full-access) rules require a licensed instance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Action allowed (create, read, update, delete, share).
- `collection` (String) Collection the permission applies to.

### Optional

- `fields` (List of String) Allowed fields for the action (["*"] for all).
- `permissions` (String) Filter rules restricting which items the action applies to (JSON).
- `policy` (String) UUID of the policy this permission belongs to (omit for public).
- `presets` (String) Preset values applied on create (JSON).
- `validation` (String) Validation rules for create/update payloads (JSON).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned permission id.
